description: RHYTHM + METER = COLLAPSE OVER A FOOT CODEBOOK (graph data). A line of verse is perceived into a STRESS PATTERN (a sequence of weak 'w' / strong 'S' syllables) by the held phonology (CMUdict ARPABET stress digits; OOV/nonsense words by an English default-stress heuristic). The pattern is DECODED against this FOOT codebook (each ShapeSignatureMeter carries a foot's base_pattern; the adapter tiles it to the line length into a ShapeSignature{kind:'foot_tiled'} decode-part, foot-agnostically) via reflective_faculty.compose_design_for_goal = the Rust ShapeDecode Term. The foot whose tiling best fits (max shape_fit, position-aligned over the whole line) WINS — the FOOT is the ShapeDecode verdict, not a Python scan. The LINE meter = the winning foot x the foot count (syllables // foot length; greek numeral). A stress pattern no seeded foot tiles to cover well (best fit < line length) has residual rhythm -> the sd loop (seeds/shape_decode_loop.json) mints a quantum -> domains/metrical_reading.py installs the pattern's minimal repeating unit as a NEW ShapeSignatureMeter foot + bumps codebook_epoch -> re-decode recognizes the learned meter. The prosodic twin of reading_collapse's construction codebook and ink_decode's stroke codebook: one collapse, one domain over into RHYTHM.

microtheory.name: prosodic_meter
microtheory.description: rhythm/meter is ShapeDecode over a foot codebook; a novel meter is minted, not hand-scanned

attrs.name: iamb
attrs.note: weak-STRONG (da-DUM). The default English metrical foot; iambic pentameter/tetrameter are the workhorse verse meters.

attrs.name: trochee
attrs.note: STRONG-weak (DUM-da). Blake's 'Tyger tyger burning bright' is trochaic tetrameter (catalectic).

attrs.name: anapest
attrs.note: weak-weak-STRONG (da-da-DUM). The galloping foot ('The Assyrian came down...').

attrs.name: dactyl
attrs.note: STRONG-weak-weak (DUM-da-da). Longfellow's Evangeline is dactylic hexameter.
